messages:
Ashley (CS): Morning — Mariner asked for a quick gatecheck before we flip prod traffic to the private deployment. Major open items: NAT egress IPs, KMS key access for inference, the IAM role for the redwood-agent, and audit log forwarding to their Splunk instance. Who owns final sign-off? cc @Mike (Platform) @Tara (Security)
Mike (Platform): I'll own NAT/peering. Eli, can you validate route tables and whether we need a specific SNAT config? They plan to use managed NAT GW across 3 AZs.
Eli (SRE): Checking route tables now. Quick clarifying Q: do they require source-NAT (SNAT) so egress appears from NAT IPs, or do they plan to use proxying? If SNAT, we need the allowlist IPs from their side.
Tara (Security): I put together a KMS key policy draft. Need Mariner's KMS ARN + the service principal that will call GenerateDataKey/Decrypt. Also want CloudTrail selectors to include S3 and kms:GenerateDataKey events.
Ashley (CS): They said they can provide the KMS ARN by EOD. They also want audit logs into mariner-prod-analytics Splunk HEC. Eli — can FluentD/forwarder support their HEC endpoint? @InfraBot can you paste current forwarder config?
InfraBot: current forwarder config:
```yaml
outputs:
  - type: splunk_hec
    url: https://hec.mariner.internal:8088
    token: REDACTED
  - index: redwood-audit
```
Note: token will need rotation per Mariner security policy.
Mike (Platform): Security groups updated: redwood-agent outbound 443 -> mariner egress IPs. I also created role `redwood-agent-mariner` with managed policy `Redwood/PrivDeployAgent` — pending Tara approval for KMS usage.
Tara (Security): I'll review the role + policy tonight. Two points: 1) KMS permission should be `kms:Decrypt` (no broader kms:*). 2) Add condition restricting `aws:SourceVpc` to the mariner-prod-vpc to mitigate cross-account misuse.
Ashley (CS): Action items captured: Mike -> finalize SGs + role; Tara -> approve KMS policy; Eli -> confirm forwarder + egress IP list; Mariner -> provide KMS ARN + Splunk HEC token. I'll schedule a 15-min sign-off call tomorrow 10:30 PT.
Eli (SRE): Confirmed egress IPs: 52.11.22.33, 52.11.22.34, 52.11.22.35. FluentD can TLS to HEC and we can enable cert pinning. Quick question: do they want CloudTrail only, or CloudTrail + VPC Flow Logs forwarded?
Ashley (CS): They asked for both CloudTrail and VPC Flow Logs. Also requested retention: 90 days in our account and 365 days in their archive bucket.
Mike (Platform): We can set S3 lifecycle to move to their archive after 90 days. Also they need an ACS URL for SAML trust in IAM — @Ashley (CS) can you get that and send it to them?
Ashley (CS): Sent ACS/metadata to mariner-security@mariner.io and added the calendar invite.
Tara (Security): One last ask before sign-off: provide KMS rotation cadence and whether they enforce multi-region replication for keys. If not replicated, we need a fallback key policy to cover failover AZs.
Ashley (CS): I'll pull their rotation docs and confirm replication. Thanks everyone :pray: 
Mike (Platform): If we have all artifacts by EOD, we can cut the IAM role and SGs and be ready for the call.
Eli (SRE): I'll prepare the forwarder test run and share a smoke log snippet before the call.
Ashley (CS): Perfect — I'll post a short pre-call checklist here 30m before.
